skill.name: frontend-agent
skill.description: Guides frontend development for Unite-Hub with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, responsive layouts, shadcn/ui components, and route updates.
skill.summary: Build and refine Unite-Hub frontend pages, components, layouts, and UI behavior.
skill.author: CleanExpo

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown code fences, inline code formatting, Tailwind examples, relative fetch calls, and a standard Next.js dynamic import. Two findings are confirmed because the skill recommends unpinned npx shadcn@latest commands that execute registry-provided code during component installation.

remediation.issue: Unpinned external package execution in shadcn installation examples.
remediation.suggestion: Replace npx shadcn@latest examples with a pinned package version and tell users to review the command before running it.

remediation.issue: Large markdown examples create many noisy static-analysis hits.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that shell blocks are optional manual commands and separate executable commands from illustrative code samples.

finding_verdicts.reason: The dynamic import is a documented Next.js performance pattern for loading a local HeavyChart component. It does not load attacker-controlled code or remote modules.

content.value_statement: Frontend work can drift from product design and data isolation requirements. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused guidance for Unite-Hub UI changes.
actual_capabilities: Guides React 19 and Next.js App Router page updates.
Provides patterns for shadcn/ui dialogs, cards, buttons, and navigation.
Documents workspace filtering requirements for Supabase queries.
Shows responsive Tailwind CSS layout patterns for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Includes examples for loading states, error states, and toast feedback.
Describes manual visual, accessibility, and performance checks.
limitations: It is tailored to the Unite-Hub project structure and design system.
It does not include automated tests or runnable helper scripts.
Some examples are illustrative and need adaptation before production use.
Component installation commands require user review before execution.

use_cases.title: Fix dashboard UI issues
use_cases.description: Use the skill to update layouts, loading states, and component styling while keeping Unite-Hub design tokens consistent.

use_cases.title: Add dashboard routes
use_cases.description: Use the route and navigation examples to create a new dashboard page with metadata, cards, and breadcrumbs.

use_cases.title: Review workspace-safe UI data access
use_cases.description: Use the workspace filtering checklist to catch frontend queries that could show data from the wrong workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a simple layout bug
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for a known page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-agent skill to fix the layout on the dashboard contacts page. Keep the existing design tokens and make it responsive.

prompt_templates.title: Add a dashboard page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-agent skill to add an Analytics page under the dashboard. Add navigation, metadata, responsive cards, and loading states.

prompt_templates.title: Implement button behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-agent skill to implement the Hot Leads send email button. Call the correct API route and show success or error toast feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a frontend change for V1
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-agent skill to review this frontend diff for workspace filtering, responsive design, accessibility, and shadcn/ui consistency.

output_examples.input: Fix the dashboard stat cards on mobile.
output_examples.output: A concise implementation plan that identifies the page, updates Tailwind breakpoints, preserves design tokens, and lists manual viewport checks.

output_examples.input: Add loading and error states to the contacts page.
output: Add loading and error state handling.
Render spinner, error banner, or data content.

output_examples.input: Review this page for V1 readiness.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering workspace filtering, responsive behavior, shadcn/ui usage, accessibility labels, and visible error handling.

best_practices: Read the project design system before generating new UI components.
Filter workspace-owned data before rendering frontend views.
Test mobile, tablet, desktop, loading, error, and empty states.
anti_patterns: Do not use generic shadcn defaults without project-specific styling.
Do not create frontend queries that omit workspace filtering.
Do not run external component installation commands without review.

faq.question: What projects is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for the Unite-Hub frontend and assumes its Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, and shadcn/ui conventions.

faq.question: Can it build new React components?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides patterns for creating and updating React components that follow the project design system.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents component installation commands, but users should review and approve external commands before running them.

faq.question: Does it cover accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It reminds agents to check ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus states, and screen reader support.

faq.question: Does it handle backend API work?
faq.answer: Only from the frontend side. It shows how UI code calls API routes, but backend implementation belongs to a backend-focused skill.

faq.question: Can it help with data isolation?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes workspace filtering for Supabase-backed views and lists tables that require workspace constraints.
